title: Review zoning/site conditions
action: Use the property's official zoning designation as an input to the applicable project review; the planner does not determine zoning compliance from the district alone.
preparation: Project dimensions and proposed site plan if zoning review requires them

title: Historic review
action: Check the applicable Newton historic-review track before exterior work or other work that triggers review.

title: Floodplain review
action: Verify whether the proposed work is within the applicable floodplain jurisdiction and what review it triggers.

title: Building permit workflow
action: Enter Newton's building-permit workflow and verify the exact application subtype, drawings, calculations, and supporting documents for this scope.

title: Electrical permit
action: Evaluate the separate electrical permit and inspection workflow for the electrical scope.

title: Electrical scope needs clarification
action: Confirm whether any wiring, fixtures, equipment, or other electrical work will be added or altered before deciding whether a separate electrical permit applies.

title: Plumbing permit
action: Evaluate the separate plumbing permit and inspection workflow for the plumbing scope.

title: Plumbing scope needs clarification
action: Confirm whether plumbing fixtures or piping will be added, moved, or altered before deciding the plumbing workflow.

title: Gas permit
action: Evaluate the separate gas permit and inspection workflow for the gas scope.

title: Gas scope needs clarification
action: Confirm whether gas piping or gas equipment will be added, moved, or altered.

title: Structural documentation
action: Confirm the structural scope and whether plans, calculations, or professional documentation are required for the proposed work.

title: Structural scope needs clarification
action: Do not assume the work is non-structural. Identify the affected walls, beams, columns, joists, framing, or foundation before finalizing the plan.

title: Fire plan review
action: Determine whether Newton Fire approval is required for this scope and prepare the applicable work description and plans.

title: Tree Permit evaluation
action: Evaluate Newton Tree Permit requirements before exterior construction starts, including whether construction may affect protected trees.
preparation: Tree Permit application for exterior construction

title: Tree impact needs clarification
action: Determine whether the exterior work could affect trees or fall within a regulated Tree Save Area before construction.

title: Conservation review
action: Route the site to Conservation review and verify the applicable wetland, stream, or floodplain jurisdiction.

title: FAR / zoning analysis
action: Perform a current Newton zoning/FAR analysis using the actual project geometry; do not infer compliance from a rough description.

title: Exterior scope needs clarification
action: Confirm whether the work changes the exterior envelope, creates an exterior opening, excavates outside, or otherwise changes the site.

title: Ventilation scope
action: Include the proposed ventilation/exhaust work in the building and applicable trade review and verify the exact requirements for the design.

title: Ventilation scope needs clarification
action: Determine whether new or altered ventilation/exhaust is part of the project before finalizing the plan.

title: Exterior opening review
action: Include new or enlarged exterior windows/doors in the building and site review; project-specific dimensions and location may affect requirements.

title: Exterior opening needs clarification
action: Confirm whether exterior windows or doors will be added, enlarged, or relocated before finalizing the scope.

title: Emergency egress
action: Verify the applicable egress requirements using actual opening, grade, well/bulkhead, and room measurements. The planner does not declare an opening compliant from a description alone.

title: Sleeping-room use needs clarification
action: Clarify whether the room is intended for sleeping because that can change applicable code and egress requirements.

title: Bathroom scope needs clarification
action: Clarify whether a bathroom and its plumbing fixtures are part of the project before finalizing the trade-permit workflow.

title: Inspections and final
action: Plan required inspections, trade/department signoffs, final inspection, and permit closeout.

title: Existing open permits
action: Check Newton permit records for open permits before finalizing the project plan or relying on existing work.

title: Historic review based on building age
action: Because the property record indicates a building older than 50 years, confirm the applicable Newton Historical Commission review for exterior alterations before relying on the standard building workflow.

title: Check for Landmark / Preservation Restriction / other historic status
action: Newton's public historic workflow includes Local Landmarks, Preservation Restrictions, and other historic-status checks that are not fully represented by the historic-district GIS layer. Confirm whether any apply to the property.

title: Energy-code review
action: Determine the applicable Massachusetts/Newton energy-code pathway and whether the project triggers HERS, ventilation, electrification, or other energy documentation.

when: project.expansion == true || project.siteWork == true || project.structuralChanges == true
title: Engineering review
action: Confirm whether Newton Engineering review, stamped plans, survey information, or site/utility documentation applies to the proposed work.

title: Water and sewer review
action: Newton's building materials identify additional water/sewer requirements for certain older dwellings, projects gutting more than 50%, or increases over 1,000 square feet. Confirm the Engineering Department policy for this project.

title: Water and sewer scope needs clarification
action: Confirm the extent of gutting and/or added floor area because those facts can change the water/sewer review.
preparation: Estimate of percentage of structure being gutted

title: Condominium documentation
action: Newton's building checklist identifies condominium notification when applicable. Separately confirm any association approval or shared-building requirements before construction.

title: Demolition / removal review
action: Confirm whether the removed work requires demolition-related review or a separate demolition permit, especially for structures or partial demolition.

title: Final as-built and signoff documentation
action: Plan for final documentation and applicable departmental signoffs. Newton's residential final checklist includes trade signoffs and, when applicable, engineering, fire, planning, conservation, historic, tree, FAR, HERS, and as-built information.

title: Use the current Newton application portal
action: Use Newton's current NewGov workflow for applicable planning/building applications and track communications there.

title: Site work needs clarification
action: Clarify whether grading, excavation, retaining walls, drainage, or other work outside the building footprint is planned because it can trigger additional site review.

title: Condominium status needs clarification
action: Confirm whether the property is subject to condominium or shared-building requirements before finalizing the workflow.

title: Demolition scope needs clarification
action: Confirm what existing work will be removed before finalizing the application path.
preparation: Description of existing work to be removed

title: Major/addition energy review
action: Confirm the applicable energy-code pathway for the final design.

title: Condominium / association approval
action: Keep the condominium or association approval/notification documentation with the project file and confirm any building-specific requirements before construction.

title: Condominium approval needs clarification
action: Confirm the association's approval or notification requirements before finalizing the construction workflow.

title: Basement room dimensions
action: Verify the proposed sleeping-room dimensions and ceiling conditions against the applicable Massachusetts requirements. The planner does not declare a basement room habitable from a single measurement.

title: Basement area and existing-condition documentation
action: Use the basement area and existing-condition measurements when preparing drawings and evaluating the scope; confirm any project-specific zoning or code implications with the permit reviewer.

title: Bathroom layout change
action: Include the changed room layout, fixture locations, and affected walls/openings in the plans and verify the applicable building, plumbing, ventilation, and electrical requirements.
preparation: Existing and proposed bathroom floor plan

title: Bathroom layout change needs clarification
action: Confirm whether walls, doors, fixtures, or room layout will change before finalizing the plan.

title: Elevated deck structure review
action: Use the proposed deck height, structure, stairs, and guards in the building-code review. Exact guard, stair, structural, and foundation requirements depend on the final design and site conditions.
preparation: Stair and guard dimensions if applicable

title: Deck stairs / guards
action: Include stairs and guard details in the building plans and verify the applicable Massachusetts requirements for the final design.

title: Deck stairs / guards need clarification
action: Confirm whether the deck has stairs, guards, or other fall-protection features before finalizing the building-plan scope.

title: Deck site / lot-coverage review
action: Include the proposed deck footprint in the site and zoning review because Newton's building checklist calls for existing and proposed lot coverage, setbacks, and related site information.

title: Multi-story addition review
action: A multi-story addition requires the proposed story count, building height, elevations, structural design, and zoning/site implications to be reviewed together.

title: Addition footprint / site-plan review
action: Treat the changed building footprint as a site-planning issue and verify setbacks, lot coverage, open space, grades, height, and related site constraints before finalizing the design.
preparation: Existing/proposed lot coverage and open space

title: Addition footprint needs clarification
action: Confirm whether the addition changes the building footprint before deciding which site and zoning reviews are needed.

title: Setback verification
action: Verify the proposed addition location against the applicable Newton setbacks using a current survey/site plan. A user-entered distance is not treated as proof of compliance.
